scenes.title: Outlined
scenes.narration: One map in five looks. First outlined: the browser, then the API, then the database, each with a bold line round it, like a sticker.

scenes.title: Line art
scenes.narration: Then line art: the browser, then the API, then the database, in ink lines on paper and nothing else.

scenes.title: Paper grain
scenes.narration: Then printed on paper: the browser, then the API, then the database, a fine grain over every face.

scenes.title: Duotone
scenes.narration: Then duotone: the browser, then the API, then the database, two inks on paper, the colours that mean something kept.

scenes.title: Sketchy
scenes.narration: And sketchy: the browser, then the API, then the database, each drawn by hand, its sides hatched like a pencil sketch.
